title: Observe responses with 5.03 do not record peer backoff state
description:
File: python/src/lichen/client/ip_coap.py

Summary: The AiocoapResourceSubscription._results() method yields CoapResult objects without checking for 5.03 Service Unavailable responses or recording backoff state in the parent transport. This violates the spec 07 section 10.2.3 requirement: Senders receiving 5.03 MUST back off for the indicated duration.

Failure Scenario:
1. Client has an active Observe relationship with peer P
2. Peer P becomes congested and sends a 5.03 notification with Max-Age: 60
3. _results() yields this as a normal CoapResult
4. Transport _peer_backoffs dict is NOT updated
5. Client immediately calls request() to peer P
6. Request goes through because no backoff is recorded
7. Result: client contributes to peer congestion, violating the spec MUST requirement

Location: Lines 353-364 in _results() async generator - no 5.03 check or backoff recording.
Contrast with request() at lines 196-216 which properly records backoff and raises ServiceUnavailableError.

Fix: AiocoapResourceSubscription needs a reference to the transport backoff state (or a callback) to record 5.03 responses.
